covers: Tuesday 17 November 2026 US session close and SA overnight, to 06:00 SAST Wednesday
headline: Nvidia beats with $115.8bn revenue and guides to $130bn after Wall Street's 1% fall; SA October CPI this morning, SARB on Thursday
summary: Nvidia reported quarterly revenue of $115.8bn after Tuesday's US close, about 6.5% above the $108.7bn consensus, and guided to $130bn for the current quarter (company release, 17 Nov 2026). On Tuesday the S&P 500 closed 1.0% lower at 7,341, the JSE All Share 0.8% lower at 110,616, and the rand was at R16.95/$ early on Wednesday (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 17-18 Nov 2026). Gold closed 2.1% lower at $3,797 and platinum 4.4% lower at $1,410, while today's October CPI and Thursday's SARB decision (repo 7.25%) are the main local tests.

items.title: Nvidia quarterly revenue $115.8bn, ahead of the $108.7bn consensus; guides to $130bn
items.summary: Nvidia reported third-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $115.8bn for the quarter to October, up 20% from $96.2bn in the previous quarter and about 103% from $57.0bn a year earlier. That is about 6.5% above the average analyst estimate of $108.7bn. For the fourth quarter, which includes an extra week, the company expects revenue of $130.0bn plus or minus 3% and gross margins of 71%-72%, and assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China.
items.source: NVIDIA Form 8-K, Exhibit 99.1 (SEC EDGAR), filed 17 Nov 2026, read by LRC Research 18 Nov 2026 06:47 SAST; consensus from LRC Earnings Calendar (market data feed, 42 estimates), 17 Nov 2026

items.title: October CPI today, SARB on Thursday

items.title: Nvidia results above estimates; our rating unchanged
items.summary: Revenue of $115.8bn beat the $108.7bn consensus and the $130bn fourth-quarter outlook is a further step up (company release, 17 Nov 2026). Our BUY rating and $262.56 fair value are unchanged; the LRC Stock Scanner will reassess after the share price reaction.
